name: Kawariyuku Kanojo ~Osananajimi wa Dou Agaite mo Netorareru~
original_name: 変わりゆく彼女 ～幼なじみはどうあがいても寝取られる～
source:
One day, the protagonist Hayama Ryou, who has just moved up to his second year at the academy, recalls inviting his neighbor and childhood friend, Orihara Aina, to play when they were little. Back then, Aina was shy and reserved, to appease her strict though well-meaning parents, she played the role of a "quiet, good girl." Because of this, she had few friends, but since their families were relatives and close, the two of them were as intimate as siblings of the same age.

In a day that now feels like the distant past, Ryou gave Aina a hair clip as a gift and tried to coax her out of the house. Because she still had homework to finish, Aina said she couldn't go out to play. On a sudden whim, he suggested she choose one of three things: "Hero Play," "Soccer," or "Continuing her Homework".

He didn't realize that those three choices would become the turning point that would drastically change Aina’s future:

If she chose "Hero Play": She would become a dignified Karate girl, brimming with a sense of justice.

If she chose "Soccer": She would become a cheerful, adorable, dog-like sports girl, as if wagging her tail with energy.

If she chose "Continuing her Homework": She would become a serious, bespectacled indoor-type girl.

Each version of Aina grew up beautifully and stayed by Ryou's side. He believes that because it has been this way until now, it will surely remain so forever. However, the young man is unaware that this baseless conviction is nothing more than a delusion.

Upon the alluring bodies of each Aina, the glares of males, glistening with desire, are already clinging to them in a thick, lewd manner...
translation:
有一天，刚升入学院二年级的主人公叶山亮回忆起了小时候邀请邻居、儿时好友折原爱奈一起玩的情景。那时的艾娜害羞又矜持，为了安抚严厉但善意的父母，她扮演了一个“安静的好女孩”的角色。正因为如此，她的朋友很少，但由于两家是亲戚，关系亲密，两人就像同龄的兄弟姐妹一样亲密。

在一个现在感觉像是遥远过去的日子里，凉送给爱娜一个发夹作为礼物，并试图哄她走出家门。因为还有作业要完成，艾娜说她不能出去玩。他突发奇想，建议她选择三件事之一：“英雄比赛”、“足球”或“继续做作业”。

他没有想到，这三个选择将成为彻底改变艾娜未来的转折点：

如果选择“英雄出击”：她将成为一个端庄、充满正义感的空手道少女。

如果她选择“足球”：她就会成为一个开朗、可爱、像狗一样摇着尾巴、精力充沛的运动女孩。

如果她选择“继续作业”：她就会变成一个严肃的、戴着眼镜的室内型女孩。

每个版本的爱娜都美丽地成长并陪伴在Ryou的身边。他相信，既然一直如此，那么也必定会永远如此。然而，年轻人并不知道，这种毫无根据的信念只不过是一种错觉。

每一个艾娜的诱人肉体上，都已经挂满了闪烁着欲望光芒的男性目光，浓浓的淫荡……
